messages:
Priya (PM): Quick async pulse — Q2 OKR milestone check. Please reply with: 1) shipped vs slipped, 2) blocker/dep, 3) next action and owner. Keep one line per owner. Owners: @Evan, @Lucy, @Santiago, @Marc, @Alyssa. Deadline: EOD tomorrow. Thanks!

Evan: Search sharding rollout: shipped (canary) ✅. Remaining: prod rollout next week. Dep: infra autoscale fix (eng-infra). Next: coordinate prod bake, owner @Evan.

Lucy: Embeddings migration: slipped 2 days due to CI flakes. Dep on eng-sre for test infra. Next: triage flaky test, aim to ship Wed. Owner @Lucy.

Santiago: Dedicated capacity chargeback UI: shipped MVP. Follow-ups: telemetry gaps reported. Next: add cost-per-token metric, owner @Santiago.

Marc: Runtime v2 latency tuning: slipped — GPU kernel regression. Blocker: model-ops patch in testing. Next: hotfix PR by Friday, owner @Marc. cc @eng-runtime

Alyssa: Console rollouts: shipped canary, some users saw missing traces. Probably index lag. Next: fallback and reindex job scheduled. Owner @Alyssa.

Priya (PM): Thanks. Two cross-cutting deps to note: 1) eng-infra autoscale fix (blocks search prod rollout), owner @DevInfraTeam. 2) SRE test infra stable, owner @Evan? should we set up a pairing? @Lucy please confirm.

Lucy: Yep pairing ok. I'll book 1hr with @Evan tomorrow 10am PT. :calendar: 

Evan: Set.

Santiago: Telemetry: filing small RFC today, will link here.

Marc: I'll prioritize kernel hotfix. If delayed >48h we trigger fallback to previous runtime. :warning: 

Priya (PM): If anyone expects slippage beyond next week, call it out now so we can adjust OKR pacing. Also, quick ask — add 1-line to this thread by EOD tomorrow confirming ship date or slip.

OpsBot: Reminder: please update the milestone board JIRA tickets — automated report runs at 2am. :robot_face: 

Alyssa: :thumbsup: I'll update the tickets after reindex job.

Santiago: RFC: https://rwood.company/rfc/telemetry-costs (will post PR link once ready).

Evan: Search prod bake scheduled Mon 09:00 PT. Noted autoscale dep.

Priya (PM): Great. I'll compile and send consolidated note to execs by Friday AM. Thanks all.
